s.t:
Was wir suchen
Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Product Owner (m/w/d) für unser Tech Team (hybrid/remote).
Das sind deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Lead-Matching-Software – unserer eigens entwickelten Kernanwendung zur automatisierten Neukundengewinnung.
Du sorgst dafür, dass die Entwicklung reibungslos voranschreitet und unsere Entwickler jederzeit an den richtigen Prioritäten arbeiten.
Du konzipierst eigenständig neue Features, nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen und von Usern auf und übersetzt sie in klare Arbeitspakete (z. B. Tickets, Mockups etc.).
Du prüfst neue Features auf Funktionalität und Qualität, begleitest den Release-Prozess und verantwortest den Live-Gang.
Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen I T, Fachabteilungen und externen Dienstleistern und sorgst während des gesamten Entwicklungsprozesses für eine transparente Kommunikation.
Du hältst alle relevanten Stakeholder regelmäßig über den aktuellen Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden.
Du identifizierst, konzipierst und implementierst AI-Anwendungen , die unsere Softwarelösungen und internen Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter machen – von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns

Du lernst die Leadbase (Matching, Dialer, Partner-Portal, Versand & Abrechnung sowie APIs) und die wichtigsten Stakeholder aus Vertrieb, Operations und Tech kennen.
Du übernimmst die Pflege des Backlogs sowie die laufende Priorisierung der Tickets im Tech-Team.
Du setzt erste kleinere Verbesserungen eigenständig um – von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Qualitätssicherung bis zum Live-Gang.
Du etablierst regelmäßige Kommunikationsformate (z. B. wöchentliche Status-Updates oder Release Notes) und hältst Fachabteilungen sowie Management über den Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden.

Du verantwortest eigenständig ein größeres Feature oder eine Produktinitiative der Leadbase – von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Rollout.
Du stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Fachbereichen und priorisierst Anforderungen nach ihrem Nutzen und ihrer Relevanz.
Du identifizierst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI und setzt erste Prozessoptimierungen um (z. B. zur Automatisierung von Anforderungsprozessen oder zur Steigerung der internen Produktivität).

Du gestaltest die Produktstrategie für Lead Matching und angrenzende Module (z. B. Dialer, Multi-Channel und Partner-API) aktiv mit und bringst mindestens ein strategisches Vorhaben erfolgreich in Produktion.
Du hast mindestens eine KI-Lösung erfolgreich produktiv eingeführt.
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Produktfragen rund um die Leadbase und wirst von Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern als verlässliche Schnittstelle wahrgenommen.
Das bringst du mit
Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem agilen Umfeld mit – idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Tech-Unternehmen.
Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und hast Freude daran, die Brücke zwischen Business und Entwicklung zu schlagen.
Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit künstlicher Intelligenz oder ein fundiertes Interesse daran, KI-Lösungen praxisnah im Unternehmenskontext einzusetzen.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und proaktiv und kannst komplexe Anforderungen in klare Aufgaben und Prioritäten übersetzen.
Du kommunizierst sicher und verständlich – auch bei technischen Themen und mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Du begeisterst dich für datengetriebene, digitale Produkte und hast den Anspruch, Dinge aktiv voranzubringen und nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Das bieten wir dir
Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld sowie die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam “The Lead Company” aufzubauen.
Ein riesiger Markt und zahlreiche interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – wir lösen das größte Problem unserer Partner: die Automatisierung ihrer Neukundengewinnung.
Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (remote, im Bremer Headquarter oder nach Absprache auch aus dem Ausland).
Volle Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit – du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten individuell mit deinem Team.
30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr + die Möglichkeit, jederzeit unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen.
Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead‑Rente”).
Jährliche Teamevents wie Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier.
Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – moderne Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum unterstützen dich bei der täglichen Arbeit.
Zuschuss fürs Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E‑Gym Wellpass).
Schnelle Entscheidungen – wir sind 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und unabhängig von Investoren.
Eine offene Feedback‑Kultur und regelmäßige interne Trainings.
Transparente Kommunikation durch monatliche All‑Hands‑Meetings , wöchentlichen Newsletter und feste Team‑Updates.
Im Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt erwarten dich ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, großartiger Kaffee & Espresso, Getränke und Grillabende.
Für Home‑Office‑Mitarbeitende: monatliche Home‑Office‑Pauschale von 20 €.
Bikeleasing, lease dein Wunschfahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen.
Das sind unsere Werte
Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.
Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.
Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

Swiftly is a retail digital technology company headquartered in the Bay Area that empowers regional and independent grocers to compete in a digital-first world.

Swiftly provides best-in-class app, web, loyalty, and e-commerce solutions to retailer partners without SaaS fees, instead driving revenue through its retail media network and sharing profits with retailers. With 70+ retailer banners and Series C funding, Swiftly is the first in the industry to seamlessly connect digital and in-store shopping.

AI is at the core of how we build, operate, and scale, powering everything from shopper personalization to internal engineering velocity. Our solutions, including Audience Optimizer™, Alcohol Cashback, and Offsite Campaigns, drive shopper engagement and brand success.

Swiftly is searching for a Principal Product Managerwho will lead and own the product development lifecycle.This role will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution, balancing strategic prioritization with hands-on execution.

This role will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to apply AI-driven automation across retail workflows, delivering innovative products that improve operational efficiency, and enhance the digital shopping experience. This is a full-time contract role. We use Deel as the employer of record and contract.

Responsibilities Include: Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap for AI-powered shopping experiences and digital marketing solutions Lead AI initiatives that automate complex marketing workflows, reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency Partner with Marketing, Engineering, and customers to understand business processes, identify pain points, and translate them into AI-powered product opportunities Drive the design and development of AI-powered products, intelligent workflows, and AI agents that automate complex business processes and improve operational efficiency Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable AI product solutions Partner with engineering, design, and business teams to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and technical feasibility Stay informed about AI and retail technology trends to identify opportunities for product innovation and workflow automation Gather feedback from internal and external stakeholders to identify pain points, opportunities, and enhancements for the platform Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure success and guide future improvements Other related duties as assigned Required Qualifications: 7+ years of product management or engineering experience, delivering highly technical products Experience with subscription products, pricing, and/or demonstrated success in improving user retention Demonstrated experience building products powered by LLMs, AI agents, or intelligent workflow automation.

Ability to identify operational processes and apply AI technologies to automate decision-making, improve efficiency, and reduce manual work Demonstrated data-driven approach to problem solving by gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data, using customer feedback and business insights to drive product decisions Experience managing a portfolio of products.

Experience working across multiple engineering teams simultaneously Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous environments Healthy balance of both analytical and creative thinking with a desire to discover and fulfill the needs of clients as well as end users Experience with SaaS platforms, developer ecosystems, or enterprise-scale solutions Excellent communication and collaboration skills Preferred Qualifications: Experience in a hyper-growth startup environment  Demonstrated ability across customer segmentation, new product strategy, execution, and product analytics  Passion for technology and a commitment to expanding technical knowledge  Working For Swiftly We are working on a set of problems that require the best in the industry to get right.

Our employees are the pillars of the future of the company and they are treated and compensated as such. We're a growing team of experienced industry professionals building an organization that can solve tough problems and values a collaborative environment.

Every Swiftly employee: -Has demonstrated the ability to work collaboratively in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment -Takes ownership of their domain from the ground up, from inception through deployment to customers -Leaves their ego at the door and ensures the best idea leaves the room -Is always experimenting with new technologies and learning new skillsets If you've ever wanted to work on a project that blends a gorgeous consumer experience, sophisticated logistics, and scale that rivals the largest technology players, Swiftly is the place for you.

Equal Opportunity Employer Swiftly is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Swiftly will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the subsequent application process. Originally posted on Himalayas

Unser Kunde ist ein großer deutscher Dienstleistungskonzern mit einem sehr großen Endkundenstamm und hohem Serviceaufkommen am Telefon. Diesen Service entwickelt er mit KI und Automatisierung konsequent weiter: einfache Anliegen übernimmt zunehmend die Technologie, die Menschen konzentrieren sich auf das Komplexe.

Wir suchen den Kopf, der diese KI-gestützte Contact-Center-Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb aufbaut, ein eigenes Team dafür führt und den telefonischen Kundenservice damit auf die nächste Stufe hebt.
​
Deine Aufgaben
Mit direkter Berichtslinie zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice trägst Du die volle Verantwortung für die Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb, führst ein eigenes interdisziplinäres Team und schlägst die Brücke zwischen Fachbereich und IT. Das beinhaltet im Detail:
Du konzipierst die Lösung und treibst die Automatisierung im telefonischen Service voran.
Du übersetzt die Anforderungen in klare User Stories für Voice- und Chatbots und verantwortest den Backlog.
Du steuerst die Umsetzung Ende zu Ende, mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung von Projektzielen und Budget bis zur Führung eines interdisziplinären, agilen Teams.
Du führst Telefonie, CRM und Bots gemeinsam mit der IT zu einer Plattform zusammen und gestaltest ihr Zusammenspiel.
Du hast den Markt im Blick, entscheidest über den Einsatz neuer Technologien und verantwortest Qualität und Effizienz im Kundenkanal.
​
Dein Profil
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner / Produktmanager an der Schnittstelle von Business und IT im Bereich Voice oder Conversational AI.
Du hast selbst Voicebots, Sprachdialogsysteme oder eine Contact-Center-Automatisierung in den Produktivbetrieb gebracht, gern mit Plattformen wie Cognigy, Genesys, Five9 oder CCAI.
Du kennst den telefonischen Kundenservice aus der Praxis und hast dort Verantwortung getragen.
Du arbeitest agil, User Stories sind für Dich selbstverständlich; Zertifizierungen wie Scrum, PRINCE2 oder PMP sind ein Plus.
Du beherrschst Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mindestens C1). Die Lösung steuert einen deutschsprachigen Kundenservice und ist ohne dieses Niveau nicht besetzbar.
​
Wir bieten
Eine Plattform, die Du gestaltest, nicht ein bestehendes System, das Du verwaltest.
Verantwortung im Aufbau, mit eigenem Team, eigenem Budget und direktem Draht zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice.
Eine exponierte Rolle, die Service, Produkt und KI verbindet und Dich für die nächste Führungsaufgabe aufstellt.
Ein attraktives, der Verantwortung entsprechendes Vergütungspaket
​
Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst Du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach Deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. Wir freuen uns auf den Austausch. Bitte lade aber vorher Deinen CV hoch, damit wir den grundsätzlichen Match einschätzen können.

Agentic AI ist deine Welt – und du willst dich damit beschäftigen, statt ständig etwas verkaufen zu müssen?
Du hast dich intensiv mit KI-Agenten beschäftigt, eigene Workflows oder Anwendungen gebaut und kennst Themen wie n8n, Make, APIs, Tool Calling, RAG, Vektordatenbanken oder MCP aus der Praxis?
Dann bau mit uns den besten Agentic-AI-Kurs im deutschsprachigen Raum.
Aufgaben
Der Titel heißt Product Manager – gemeint ist aber jemand, der Lerninhalte baut, nichtverwaltet: halb Instructional Designer, halb Agentic-AI-Bastler. Du gestaltest das Produkt „Kurs“, von der ersten Demo bis zum fertigen Modul. Dabei beschäftigst du dich mit uns zusammen unter anderem mit folgenden Fragen:
Was müssen Menschen heute über Agentic AI wissen?
Welche Tools, Modelle und Frameworks sind wirklich relevant?
Welche Agenten und Automatisierungen sollten Teil des Kurses sein?
Wie lassen sich technische Inhalte verständlich und praxisnah vermitteln?
Welche Übungen, Projekte und Demos bringen Teilnehmer wirklich weiter?
Du unterstützt uns dabei, Inhalte zu strukturieren, praktische Anwendungen zu bauen, Lernmaterialien zu entwickeln und Referenten fachlich zu begleiten. Einzelne Inhalte kannst du später auch selbst unterrichten.
Qualifikation
Wir suchen keinen Verkäufer und keinen klassischen Bildungsmanager – sondern jemanden mit technischem Hintergrund, der bereits tief in Agentic AI steckt, neue Entwicklungen aufmerksam verfolgt und komplexe Dinge verständlich erklären kann.
Ob Berufseinsteiger mit starkem Portfolio oder mit ein paar Jahren Erfahrung in Content, Training oder Produktentwicklung – entscheidend ist, was du bereits gebaut oder vermittelt hast, nicht dein Titel.

Kleines Team, kurze Wege
Hybrides Arbeits-Setup: Büro in Berlin-Mitte + Homeoffice
Tägliche Arbeit mit den aktuellsten KI-Tools und -Entwicklungen
Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - du verwaltest nicht, du baust auf
Perspektive auf eine wachsende Rolle in einem wachsenden Bereich
Vollzeit, unbefristet.
Schick uns nicht nur deinen Lebenslauf – zeig uns, womit du dich beschäftigst und was du bereits gebaut oder entwickelt hast (z.B. Kurskonzepte, Workshops, Tutorials oder Prototypen)!

We are looking for a Associate Product Delivery Manager to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams.
Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and keep track of sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.
This is a good opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.
Tasks
Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead.
Help maintain and organize the product backlog.
Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning.
Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design.
Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers.
Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.
Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.

s.h: Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.
s.t:
Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions.
Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility.
Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes.
Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop.

Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count.
Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams.
The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication.
Confidence following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments.
Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.
A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn.
Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.
Helpful, but not required
Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria.
Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes.
Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment.
You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

s.h: What success looks like within your first six months
s.t:
Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time.
Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team.
Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.
Engineering and design know where to find the information they need.
Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early.
The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery.
You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence.

We offer an exciting environment at the interface between IT and entertainment and marketing as part of an ambitious, international and results-orientated team in a young startup.
You work with an excellent international team with varied tasks with a wide range of great opportunities

Monthly learning budget
Urban Sports Club membership support
Support for your favourite means of transport - we help finance your new bike or your public transport subscription
We are a startup in one of the cultural hubs in Berlin, you'll never get bored
We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. If the role interests you but you do not meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta ’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel.

The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia.

Cresta ’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day.

Come build that future at Cresta . About the Role As our first EMEA Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent , you will create, deploy and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers.

This highly cross-functional and customer-facing role blends product thinking, a nose for value, and project leadership with senior customer executives. At the end of the day, you own each AI Agent and the outcomes they drive for our customers, and you take that personally.

You are a creative, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, rolls up your sleeves to build, and excels at turning ambiguity into execution. In this role, you’ll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will support the build, integrations and optimization to make each AI Agent successful.

You’ll also work closely with product and engineering, providing a tight feedback loop and custom tooling that will shape the future of our platform. As the first hire in EMEA, you’ll also play a key role in setting the standards for the role in the EMEA region and helping to grow the team as we scale.

What You’ll Do Own AI Agent outcomes for our customers — defining and delivering on the metrics that move the needle. This includes finding additional automation opportunities that can provide even more value!

To do this, you’ll… Own the deployment lifecycle for AI Agents — from scoping and kickoff to launch and post-go-live optimization Design, build, test and iterate on AI agents in partnership with FDEs using Cresta ’s internal tools and the latest technologies to deliver the highest customer ROI Serve as the AI Agent SME for the EMEA Sales cycle, partnering on demos, solutioning, and deal reviews to ensure technical feasibility, value articulation, and successful handoff to deployment.

Lead customer relationships and act as the primary point of contact for AI Agent. Help customers move faster to ensure we can deliver quickly and effectively.

Facilitate workshops and design sessions with customer stakeholders to align on agent use cases, workflows, and success criteria Work closely with FDEs to ensure smooth implementation, build new capabilities as needed and provide feedback and improvements to our broader platform Improve our playbooks for agent development and customer deployment Build our forward deployed practice for EMEA, setting the standards for future growth What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in Technology Consulting, Implementations, Product, or Customer Success roles, ideally working closely with AI or LLM first products Hands-on work style – curiosity with a bias for action.

You anticipate needs and bottlenecks and deliver with urgency and care.

Experience leading complex deployments, owning customer relationships (including senior customer stakeholders), and working cross-functionally Strong technical understanding, systems thinking and exposure to building Agents (not necessarily conversational, personal projects count!) Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning quickly in a dynamic startup environment Passion for AI, automation, and shaping the future of customer experience Bonus Points Background in product management, conversation design or forward deployed engineering roles Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment Familiarity with customer support and contact center operations Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced 20 days of vacation time Compensation at Cresta Cresta ’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people.

We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain.

Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai Originally posted on Himalayas

About the role Automated video editing is an emerging category, and we're positioned to define it. Media companies want to turn thousands of podcast episodes into social clips. Marketing teams want to automatically create product demos for every release. Agencies want to process client content in bulk with consistent branding.

And they want to do all of that at scale. As the Product Manager for this 0 to 1 area, you'll build and own the platform that makes this all possible. You'll create APIs that let developers programmatically import media, run AI-powered edits, and export content.

In essence, turning Descript 's already powerful editing capabilities into infrastructure that media businesses can depend on.

What you’ll do Own the API and developer experience that lets teams create content workflows at scale Launch integrations that unlock new use cases: MCP wrappers, no-code workflow platforms, and strategic partner integrations Work closely with our Agentic AI team to influence what editing capabilities we build and how they're exposed through the API Define and grow this business line by shaping positioning, pricing, and go-to-market strategy with Sales and Marketing teams Who you are You’ve shipped technical products before: You have 5 or more years of product management experience shipping internal APIs, developer platforms, and foundational systems that enable other teams You build things from scratch: Building a brand new product means venturing into the unknown, and you find that energizing rather than scary.

You've taken products from 0 to 1, figured out ambiguous problem spaces, and created the playbook to make it successful. You start with the customer : Plenty of “AI products” start with the technology and they all suck.

You care deeply about understanding customers, and have experience in doing customer discovery and defining features that solve real problems. You are funny, creative, maybe kind of weird : Ok, this isn’t a hard requirement but Descript is kind of a quirky place and the people who love it tend to like that about working here.

So, just want to drop a hint early on. Also, the sense of humor is important because even though we take our work seriously it’s still just, like, video creation and editing. We aren’t flying rockets into space so let’s all have a good time. The base salary range for this role is $171,000 - $235,000/year.

We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors ( OpenAI , Andreessen Horowitz , Redpoint Ventures , Spark Capital ).

Descript is the special company that's in possession of both product market fit and the raw materials (passionate user community, great product, large market) for growth, but is still early enough that each new employee has a measurable influence on the direction of the company.

Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time. Our headquarters are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We're hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles.

For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration. For our hybrid roles, we're flexible, and you're an adult—we don't expect or mandate that you're in the office every day.

We do believe there are valuable and serendipitous moments of discovery and collaboration that come from working together in person.

Descript is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

Unternehmensbeschreibung Wir als news aktuell GmbH sind eine 100%ige Tochter der Deutschen Presse-Agentur (dpa) und bieten mit unseren Services ots, zimpel und Presseportal.de innovative Lösungen für erfolgreiche PR und Kommunikation.

Unsere Tools beliefern Medienschaffende per Redaktionsticker oder Mail, veröffentlichen PR-Content im Web und sorgen für hohe Auffindbarkeit bei Google und Co. Auf diesem Weg verschaffen wir unseren Kundinnen und Kunden eine maximale Reichweite und Sichtbarkeit – national und international.

Unseren Erfolg als news aktuell GmbH verdanken wir unseren 135 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern, die an vier verschiedenen Standorten unsere Produkte und Lösungen vorantreiben. Unser gemeinsamer Antrieb im täglichen Miteinander sind gegenseitige Wertschätzung, Offenheit und Humor.

Ein diverses Team sowie der Austausch von Perspektiven und Kulturen sind uns wichtig. Who is Credible ?
Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level.

On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score.

On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.
About the Role: Credible is looking for an AI-native Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our student loan lending marketplace, our flagship product. You will own and deliver features from ideation through launch, in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data.

Primarily, you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps students and parents discover and compare options across multiple lenders. This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build.

In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources. You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler.

Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant. Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the product's vision and direction and to achieve team OKRs. Responsibilities:
Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the student loan marketplace and align them with Credible 's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the student loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps students and parents discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
Own the Roadmap: Manage roadmaps for both private student loans and student loan refinance products by identifying opportunities, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove when it isn't earning its place.
Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross-functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Student lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

Own the cross-product revenue breakdown: surface how each step in the shopping journey drives e-commerce business as the shared mental model that unifies merchandisers, product managers, marketers, analysts, and executives.

Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to translate highly technical constraints (e.g., GPU scheduling, latency budgets) into actionable product roadmaps.

About Netholabs
Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.
You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation
Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

Neho est l'une des principales sociétés de courtage immobilier en Suisse, redéfinissant le secteur grâce à l'innovation. Nous combinons l'expertise humaine avec des solutions numériques puissantes pour offrir une expérience immobilière plus rapide, plus transparente et plus efficace.

Notre approche a été reconnue par des prix prestigieux, dont le SEF Award 2023. Ce qui nous distingue vraiment, c'est notre modèle à prix fixe, offrant aux clients une alternative moderne aux services traditionnels basés sur la commission, propulsée par une technologie avancée.
**Nous recherchons un ingénieur produit IA pour diriger, de manière pratique, la mise en œuvre de l'IA. Vous construirez les agents qui prennent en charge les parties manuelles et répétitives de l'achat, du financement et de la vente d'une maison, afin que nos experts puissent consacrer leur temps aux moments qui comptent.**
Vous ne partirez pas de zéro. Nous avons une vision convaincante et des prototypes fonctionnels. Votre mission est de faire passer ce modèle du prototype au produit : agents réels, utilisateurs réels, résultats mesurés. Vous mettrez en production un premier agent dans vos premiers mois et développerez un pipeline à partir de là.
**Il s'agit d'un rôle de zéro à un avec une véritable responsabilité et visibilité, relevant directement de notre CTO. Si vous aimez transformer un processus manuel en logiciel fonctionnel livré en semaines plutôt qu'en trimestres, vous vous sentirez chez vous ici.**
**Charge de travail : 80 - 100%**
## **Ingénieur Produit IA** ##
### **Vos tâches** ###
* **Trouver la valeur :** Passez du temps réel avec les chefs de produit, conseillers, agents immobiliers et spécialistes des opérations, cartographiez leurs flux de travail, identifiez les cas d'utilisation des agents qui éliminent le plus de travail mesurable tout au long du parcours client ou des opérations internes - priorisez par résultat
* **Construire les agents, de manière pratique :** Concevez, construisez, testez et déployez les agents vous-même : utilisez des frameworks et plateformes d'agents là où ils sont plus rapides, du code réel là où ils ne le sont pas
* **Assumer la livraison des interfaces :** Faites passer nos prototypes au produit, et faites évoluer la manière dont les agents atteignent les utilisateurs : dans le produit, en chat, puis plus tard sur mobile
* **Construire la couche MCP :** Enveloppez les API stables du domaine dans des outils MCP fins et bien conçus à travers lesquels vos agents agissent. Vous êtes le premier et le plus exigeant consommateur de notre architecture API-first.
* **Conduire les exigences vers les équipes :** Spécifiez les API dont vos agents et interfaces ont besoin auprès des équipes d'ingénierie propriétaires du domaine, qui les construisent et les exposent ; vous consommez des contrats propres plutôt que d'accéder directement aux systèmes
* **Choisir la plateforme avec l'équipe Platform :** Dirigez la sélection de la technologie et des plateformes conjointement avec l'équipe Platform, en tenant compte de la sécurité, de la protection des données suisse/UE, du coût et de l'opérabilité
* **Livrer sur rails, dans les limites :** Déployez sur le chemin cloisonné, containerisé et uniquement API de l'entreprise ; instrumentez et évaluez vos agents ; respectez les niveaux de sensibilité des données
* **Transférer quand un agent grandit :** Quand un agent devient critique pour les revenus ou touche des données client ou financières sensibles, transférez-le à l'ingénierie pour durcissement et prise en charge à long terme, et continuez à construire le suivant
* **Mesurer les résultats :** Suivez l'effort supprimé, le temps de cycle et l'impact sur la conversion, ainsi que l'adoption par les personnes servies par les agents. Pas le nombre d'agents livrés
#### **Ce que ce rôle n'est pas** ####
* **Pas le constructeur des API principales :** Les équipes d'ingénierie du domaine possèdent et exposent les API stables ; vous conduisez les exigences, construisez les fines enveloppes MCP par-dessus, et consommez les contrats
* **Pas le propriétaire de la plateforme/infrastructure :** La plateforme possède l'exécution, le déploiement, l'observabilité et la sécurité ; vous construisez par-dessus
* **Pas un service d'assistance IA :** Vous n'êtes pas là pour construire des outils sur mesure pour chaque département ; vous construisez les agents qui font avancer nos priorités, et aidez les autres à s'auto-servir en toute sécurité sur le chemin autorisé
### **Ce que nous offrons** ###
* Responsabilité complète de votre produit avec l'autorité pour piloter la mise en œuvre, challenger le statu quo, et assumer le résultat de la conception au lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités
* Une opportunité de carrière unique pour rejoindre une scale-up en forte croissance et primée dans le secteur immobilier
* Façonnez l'avenir de la technologie immobilière en Suisse : Ayez un impact direct sur la croissance de Neho, et livrez des outils IA efficaces et évolutifs qui donnent à Neho un avantage concurrentiel
* Profitez de hiérarchies plates, de processus décisionnels rapides, et de la liberté de travailler de manière autonome et de laisser votre empreinte
* Faites partie d'une équipe dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, répartie entre nos bureaux de Lausanne et Zurich ainsi que notre équipe d'ingénierie à distance en Roumanie
* Épanouissez-vous dans une culture entrepreneuriale et innovante qui valorise la transparence, l'équité et un fort soutien d'équipe
* Avantages compétitifs incluant 5 semaines de congés + jours supplémentaires selon l'ancienneté, congé maternité/paternité entièrement payé, options de télétravail, événements d'équipe réguliers, et plus encore !
### **Ce que vous apportez** ###
* **Maîtrise de la pile IA :** Vous avez travaillé avec la pile IA moderne sous une forme ou une autre (API directes de modèles, frameworks d'agents comme LangGraph/CrewAI/Google ADK, plateformes d'orchestration comme Dify/n8n). Ce qui compte, c'est ce que vous avez livré, pas l'outil utilisé.
* **Développeur dans l'âme :** Vous avez une formation en ingénierie logicielle et écrivez et gérez du code en production depuis des années. Le langage spécifique importe peu.
* **À l'aise sur toute la pile :** Que ce soit PHP, TypeScript/JavaScript ou Python, vous êtes à l'aise pour construire des applications, des API et d'autres choses comme des extensions de navigateur ou même des applications mobiles.
* **Pragmatique sur les outils :** Vous utilisez les plateformes d'agents et outils IA là où ils sont plus rapides, et écrivez du code réel là où ils ne le sont pas. À l'aise avec MCP, webhooks, prompting et interfaces utilisateur en streaming.
* **Discipliné sur l'évaluation :** Vous avez livré des systèmes basés sur LLM à de vrais utilisateurs : vous écrivez des évaluations, concevez des quadrails, pensez aux modes de défaillance, et savez quand un agent doit refuser de répondre. Dans un domaine réglementé et riche en documents, c'est la compétence clé, pas un simple plus

About Qorelo
Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

You'll be the person who decides what we build next, and why. You'll lead our two solution architects — the people who carry our SAP domain depth — and turn what they know about real transformation projects into a roadmap our engineers can ship. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.
This is an early-stage PM role in the full sense: strategy and backlog, customer discovery and acceptance criteria, the big roadmap call and the unglamorous ticket. You'll do IC work alongside the thinking, and your decisions will show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.
What you'll own
The product roadmap. You prioritize what our AI agents learn to do next across the transformation lifecycle — from fit-to-standard analysis to post-go-live evolution — and you can defend every call with customer evidence.
The solution architects. You lead our two SAs directly, turning their module knowledge and project scar tissue into product requirements engineering can build against.
Discovery with real users. Consultants and enterprise IT teams use Qorelo inside live transformation programmes. You sit with them, watch where the product wins and where it fails, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.
The bridge between domain and build. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost in translation — and you work with our Head of Product Design so what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.
Shipping. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.
What you need
4+ years hands-on SAP experience, functional or product side — S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area like FI, SD, or PP
2+ years product experience: you've owned a roadmap, prioritized with engineering, and shipped features to real users — title doesn't matter, ownership does
Understanding of the SAP transformation lifecycle (Discover → Prepare → Explore → Realize) deep enough to talk credibly to consultants and IT leads at enterprise clients
Strong AI curiosity — you've actually built or worked with LLM/agentic tooling, not just read about it
Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, IC work alongside strategy
Fluent English; German is a plus for our DACH client base
You might be a fit if
You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought "half of this should be software" — and can name which half
You've been the person consultants trust on module questions and the person engineers trust to write a clear spec
You've built something with LLMs — a prototype, an internal tool, an agent — and formed opinions about where they break
You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters

Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction, not just your backlog. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.
Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences.

Who is Heidi?
Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that supports clinicians every step of the way, from documentation to delivery of care.
We exist to double healthcare’s capacity while keeping care deeply human. In 18 months, Heidi has returned more than 18 million hours to clinicians and supported over 73 million patient visits. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi across 116 countries and over 110 languages.
Founded by clinicians, Heidi brings together clinicians, engineers, designers, scientists, creatives, and mathematicians, working with a shared purpose: to strengthen the human connection at the heart of healthcare.
Backed by nearly $100 million in total funding, Heidi is expanding across the USA, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with major health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, MaineGeneral, and Monash Health, among others.
We move quickly where it matters and stay grounded in what’s proven, shaping healthcare’s next era. Ready for the challenge?

Heidi's core products are expanding in both scope and reach. Scribe already powers more than 3 million patient consultations a week, and Evidence and Remote are scaling behind it. We're now building out the New Bets function to create the next wave of new products.
This is a zero-to-one product role inside a company that already has proven impact and partnerships with the NHS, which is the combination every early-stage PM wants and almost never gets. Most v1s launch into silence.

Yours go in front of clinicians who already open Heidi every day, and who will tell you within a week whether you've built something they need. You can ship on a Tuesday, watch a GP use it on a Thursday, and know where you stand by Friday.

In addition to the external feedback loop, within the London Office, we have Clinicians sat within Customer Success, Regulatory Compliance and GTM, so there is plenty of lived experience within reach.
You'll own new bets end to end, not features on someone else's roadmap. You take a problem space from conviction to evidence: frame it, size the prize, prototype it, put it in front of real clinicians, and make the call. A few bets become Heidi's next product line. Most don't. Killing them cleanly, quickly and without ceremony is as much the craft as scaling the winners.
A small dedicated squad sits alongside you to build and test. If it needs a pilot scoped with a health system, you scope it. If it needs a landing page, you write it.
You might already be a PM. You might be a strategy consultant who is tired of recommending and wants to own what happens next. You might have run operations and spent the last two years fixing the product from the outside. The title matters less than the pattern: you build things, you move fast, and ambiguity makes you sharper, not slower.

Own each bet end to end: the problem it goes after, why it matters now, and the goals and success metrics you set and are held accountable to
Take each bet from thesis to evidence - frame the problem, size the prize and define what "working" means before anything gets built
Prototype fast, often yourself: a v0 built in Cursor or Claude Code beats a sprint of engineering time spent on the wrong thing
Get out of the building: sit in clinics, watch how visits actually run and turn what you see into the next sprint
Design pilots with commercial and regional teams that produce a decision. Think real accounts, real usage, honest numbers
Make the scale-or-kill call and own the narrative with founders, leadership and customers
Do whatever the bet needs: pricing, positioning, onboarding, the launch email. There's no one else to hand it to, which is the point
Graduate the winners into staffed product lines with roadmaps someone else can run, then start again

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.
We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.
We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

Location: Remote
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Chief Product Officer

Every CodePath learner engages our platform, whether they are a college CS student in a direct course, a student at a partner university, an alum sharpening their skills, or a working engineer retraining for the AI era. The Senior Product Manager, Learner Platform Experience owns this platform.
CodePath's courses work because they are intensive, industry-vetted, and human. The hard problem is scale. As we grow from tens of thousands of learners toward millions, the quality and effectiveness of the learner experience on the platform has to improve, not dilute.

That demands an AI-First approach: clearly and thoughtfully identifying where AI can accelerate effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection and touchpoints are essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress. Getting that boundary right is the core judgment call of this job, and you will make it over and over.
The ownership lines are clear. Curriculum owns what we teach. The Learning team owns how it is taught, including the live classroom. You own the platform: everything a learner touches when they log in, from the course portal to asynchronous engagement between sessions to the touchpoints that keep them moving. You will collaborate closely with Learning so the platform powers great live delivery, but the platform experience is yours.
Success looks like measurable acceleration in the rate of learning, retention, and engagement, even as the number of students grows by an order of magnitude.
Two things make this role unlike most PM jobs
Learning rate is the scoreboard. Plenty of platforms can deliver content at scale. Almost none can prove their students learn faster because of them. You will be measured on outcomes, retention, and engagement, not feature velocity.
The ceiling is enormous. Every course CodePath delivers, direct or through partners, rides on the platform experience you build. As we scale to an order of magnitude of more students, your decisions compound across every learner we will ever serve.

Own the core learner platform experience across every segment: college CS students, alumni, working engineers, and students at partner institutions
Translate learning, retention, and engagement goals into a prioritized roadmap
Use AI across your entire workflow to compress weeks into days, raising the quality and the speed of what you ship
Own our AI-assisted learning experiences end to end, including taking the AI Tutor and AI Grader from prototype to product. These student-facing AI surfaces are yours, not shared
Decide where AI accelerates effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection is essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress
Collaborate with Curriculum, Learning, and Engineering: they own what is taught and how the classroom runs, you build the platform that powers live delivery and asynchronous engagement
Set a high bar for design quality and engaging interactions across every learner touchpoint
Define the metrics that prove learning rate, retention, and engagement are improving at scale, and design experiments, grounded in discovery with users, to test your biggest bets

AI Corps is a fellowship program that sources, trains, and deploys applied AI specialists into organizations. Fellows complete an intensive program, build skills across modern AI stacks, and embed directly with partner teams to ship real work.

The first cohort, Claude Corps, is now launching in partnership with Anthropic with 1,000 fellows committed to deploy into nonprofits. The next chapter is enterprise, where the demand is larger, the budgets are real, and the urgency to build with AI is highest.

About Teramind
Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.
The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end.

You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role.

The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology.

AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability.

Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.
What You Will Own
The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control . Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local models running offline - and capturing the prompts, pastes, uploads, and agent-executed commands that browser and network DLP cannot see.
Translating business vision into engineering reality . You turn signals from executives, sales, customers, competitors and the engineering org into a coherent technical roadmap. You are the interpreter between “we need to detect AI exfiltration” and “here is how we instrument the endpoint to see it.”
Building for the enterprise: bulletproof and undetectable . Enterprise customers expect the Agent to be invisible to end users, resilient against tampering, and reliable in conditions that break weaker products. You own the roadmap that keeps it that way.
Performance, footprint, and reliability. Every CPU cycle, megabyte and battery percent we consume is felt by the end user and argued about by the customer's IT team. You set and defend the performance bar.
Define, measure, and meet product KPIs. Adoption, rollout velocity, deployment success rate, crash rates, detection coverage, time-to-patch on OS changes. You set the numbers and hold the team and the company to them.
Industry and ecosystem relationships. Microsoft, Apple, the Linux ecosystem, MDM vendors, and the major AV and EDR vendors. You represent Teramind in technical conversations where the agent's architecture is the subject.

5+ years of product management experience , with at least 3 owning a technical platform, SDK, agent, or systems-level product. This is a senior IC seat: influence without headcount.
Technical depth is non-negotiable . You do not need to write C++, but you should reason about Windows architecture, macOS system extensions, and the trade-offs between Endpoint Security and Network Extension frameworks. You can push back credibly in a design review.
You understand how AI actually runs on a computer . A hosted model in a browser tab, a native desktop client, an IDE-embedded assistant, a CLI coding agent, and a local model under Ollama are five different detection problems, and several are invisible to anything watching the network. You know why, and you know what an audit trail for an autonomous agent has to capture.
Endpoint or systems background. You have shipped endpoint security (EDR, EPP, XDR), monitoring or management agents, OS-level tools, or systems software. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender, Tanium and similar are directly relevant. Pure SaaS and application PMs without systems exposure will struggle here.
You think in outcomes, not features. Success is “95% of customers roll out a new agent version within 30 days,” not “shipped version 27.0.”
You are comfortable with security trade-offs. Visibility versus privacy, tamper protection versus usability, cloud processing versus on-device intelligence. You can hold the attacker's perspective and the IT buyer's perspective in the same conversation.
You work with AI, not just about it. You use AI in your own practice, prototyping to pressure-test concepts before spending engineering cycles, and evaluating model behavior rather than trusting vendor claims.
You bring rigor, and you write. PRDs, decision memos, prioritization frameworks, release cadence, credible engineering-facing specs. In a distributed team, writing is how product management scales.

Engineering background earlier in your career: systems, kernel, driver, or low-level platform work
Windows Filter Drivers, Minifilters or WFP; macOS Endpoint Security or Network Extensions; Linux eBPF, kernel modules or userspace agents
MDM ecosystems (Jamf, Intune, Workspace ONE, Kandji)
Insider risk, DLP, or behavioral analytics
Local model runtimes and on-device inference (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp)
Agentic AI: tool calling, MCP, and autonomous coding or workflow agents
AI governance, AI security, or shadow AI discovery products
EDR and AV co-existence and exclusion lists at scale
Why This Role
Endpoint agents are having a moment. The convergence of insider risk, DLP, AI, and hybrid work is making the endpoint the most strategically important surface in enterprise security and workforce intelligence. Teramind's Agent is one of the deepest data-collection engines in the market - we see things the rest of the category does not - and it is one of the strongest competitive moats we have.

Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information.

We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
The Retail Advertiser Experiences (RAX) team empowers businesses in the retail ecosystem to successfully achieve their marketing goals through advertising with Google - by providing compelling consumer and advertiser experiences that lead to great shopping experiences and great advertising performance, growing Google's business in the process.
Within RAX, our team builds advertiser-facing controls and intelligence tools that align ads delivery with their business needs and business objectives, and empower retail advertisers navigating the generative AI shift.

We equip retail advertisers with prioritized opportunities, transparent AI intelligence, and actionable optimization controls that drive measurable return on investment improvements, unlock incremental demand, and accelerate sustainable business growth, combined with full-stack ads delivery optimizations (such as Offer Cold-Start and Personalization) that best utilize retail signals to power delightful experiences tailored to user preferences.
Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do.

Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores.

We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.

* Define and execute the roadmap for next-generation Retail AI Ads reporting (including AI search trends and insights, alongside AI-Readiness diagnostics) to give advertisers clarity, trust, and control during the AI Search transition.
* Collaborate with core SAGE teams (retrieval, bidding, and auction) to eliminate offer delivery gaps and power Shopper-Aware Personalization, leveraging retail signals to match high-intent shoppers with the right merchant catalog.
* Engage directly with Retail advertisers and Sales/Go-to-Market teams to identify and translate customer pain points into new product innovations. Establish measurement frameworks and rapid experiment pipelines with Engineering and Data Science.
* Forge partnerships and align joint roadmaps across SAGE, Ad Platform (AP), Search/AIM, Commerce, and GBO/Sales, authoring strategy papers and leading executive reviews.

Alpaca is building the infrastructure layer that partners across the Gulf use to launch and scale brokerage products. We're expanding our footprint in Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with live market access, a growing regional roadmap, and ambitions across derivatives, direct connectivity, securities lending, and Sharia-compliant offerings.

We're hiring a Product Manager to own that expansion end-to-end: define the strategy, ship the products, and work with regulators, partners, and internal teams to make Alpaca the brokerage platform of choice across the Kingdom and the wider GCC.
We're seeking a Product Manager to define and drive new product initiatives and manage a portfolio of existing products across the Saudi and GCC markets.

With a deep understanding of the regional regulatory landscape, including CMA, Edaa, Tadawul, and GCC financial market frameworks, you will shape the product strategy that enables Alpaca to scale its brokerage infrastructure across the Kingdom and the wider Gulf region, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 and the region's rapidly evolving capital markets.
This role is equal parts strategy and delivery. You'll decide what we build versus buy, how we sequence the regional roadmap, and which partnerships and connectivity paths get us there — and then ship the brokerage features, integrations, and operational workflows that partners and institutional clients depend on every day.
What You'll Walk Into

The rest of the Saudi roadmap: prioritizing and delivering the next wave of brokerage capabilities across equities, Sukuk, ETFs, and regional market needs.
Saudi derivatives: defining and launching derivative product offerings compliant with local market structure and regulation.
Saudi direct connectivity: building and owning connectivity to Tadawul and regional infrastructure, reducing reliance on intermediary paths.
Saudi broker partnerships: evaluating, onboarding, and integrating local brokers to expand coverage and resilience.
Saudi securities lending business: growing the securities lending product line for the Kingdom.
All of the above for the UAE: replicating and adapting the Saudi playbook for the Emirates market, including local regulatory alignment and partner integrations.
Sharia-compliant products across Alpaca : owning the product strategy and delivery for Islamic finance offerings, ensuring Sharia-compliant structures are embedded across regional and global product surfaces.
Regulatory and stakeholder complexity: engagements with CMA, Tadawul, Edaa, and other regional regulators, plus coordination between Alpaca 's global platform and KSA/GCC market infrastructure.

Own brokerage products tailored for the Saudi and GCC markets, including equities, Sukuk, ETFs, derivatives, and Sharia-compliant solutions.

Lead customer calls around brokerage process and product issues to gain insights and translate them into product improvements for GCC clients.

Job Description
At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.
Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.
As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further.

You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.
This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes
Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.
Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.
Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.
Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic
Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.
Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.
Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.
Owning paid visibility and growth products
Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).
Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.
Working data-first
Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.
Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.
Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.
Operating as an AI-native Product Manager
Use AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and AI prototyping tools daily to accelerate discovery, prototyping, PRD creation, and execution.
Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.
Collaborating across teams
Work closely with Customer Success, Patient Marketing, Engineering, Data, Design, and country teams to deliver impact across markets.
Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.
Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.
What will set you up for success in this role?
Core Product Management experience
5+ years of Product Managemen t experience building digital consumer or marketplace products .
Strong product thinking and a user-centric mindset, paired with the commercial instinct to connect product decisions to business outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across both commercial and technical audiences.
Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and Data teams.
Extreme ownership, comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping products in emerging spaces.
Exceptionally data-driven
Fluent with SQL and comfortable querying large datasets to explore, size, and validate opportunities independently.
Proven ability to translate business logic into ranking, scoring, or matching logic – and to reason clearly about the trade-offs.
Strong analytical and experimentation skills; you make decisions from data and can defend them.
Deep understanding of customer economics
Strong grasp of the metrics that drive a subscription marketplace: churn, retention, engagement, activation, ARPU, and lifetime value.
Experience owning or moving retention and engagement metrics for a customer base, not just shipping features.

Welcome to the good side of tech
You might have heard about us, but with a different name: ZnanyLekarz. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit.

We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?
Docplanner at scale
We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.
At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.
We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us .
And why should you join us?
Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.
We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.
